verdicts.reason: Both have the same layout breakdown. The six checkmarks sit in an empty column with no labels, and the list items they belong to (Legs, Chin Upper lip, Ears…) are moved to the bottom right in tiny, unreadable text. The tape pieces are scattered at the bottom as loose debris, and the white note card is gone. The $50 floats beside a stray blue rule, and 'One day only to save' sits under the photo, away from the price it explains, so the reading order is jumbled. B's slightly lower placement and larger photo make no real difference.
